-- Build domain -> company name map
local companies = {
  ["acme.com"] = "Acme Corporation",
  ["globex.io"] = "Globex",
  ["initech.dev"] = "Initech",
  ["umbrella.co"] = "Umbrella Holdings",
}

-- All contacts from all 3 pages
local all_contacts = {}
for p = 1, 3 do
  local page = tool("list_contacts", {page = p})
  for _, c in ipairs(page.items) do
    all_contacts[#all_contacts + 1] = c
  end
end

-- Function to check if phone is valid E.164
local function is_e164(phone)
  return phone:match("^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$") ~= nil
end

-- Function to normalize phone to E.164
local function normalize_phone(phone)
  -- Strip all non-digits
  local digits = phone:gsub("[^0-9]", "")
  -- If 10 digits, prepend +1
  if #digits == 10 then
    return "+1" .. digits
  -- If 11 digits starting with 1, prepend +
  elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == "1" then
    return "+" .. digits
  else
    return nil -- unexpected format
  end
end

-- Function to extract domain from email
local function extract_domain(email)
  return email:match("@(.+)$")
end

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0

for _, c in ipairs(all_contacts) do
  local needs_phone_fix = not is_e164(c.phone)
  local needs_company = (c.company == "" or c.company == nil)
  
  if needs_phone_fix or needs_company then
    local params = {id = c.id}
    
    if needs_phone_fix then
      params.phone = normalize_phone(c.phone)
    end
    
    if needs_company then
      local domain = extract_domain(c.email)
      params.company = companies[domain]
    end
    
    local result = tool("update_contact", params)
    
    if needs_phone_fix then phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1 end
    if needs_company then companies_filled = companies_filled + 1 end
  end
end

return {phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled}
